description:
The `POST /connection/open` request. `previousToken` is a bearer secret
used only to prove ownership of an existing grant; it is request-only and
must never enter diagnostics, receipts, retained client state, or logs.

@ref LLP 0051#d4-finish-dk-7-the-live-envelope-becomes-schema-governed — the
  complete non-JS client HTTP surface is Rust-owned and generated.

authInvalidationProtocol.description:
Exact must-understand offer. Missing opens a legacy connection that
cannot admit session-mode auth-scoped live work; a present unknown
value refuses (`SNAPBACK_AUTH_INVALIDATION_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED`).

@ref LLP 0094#0c5-authinvalidationprotocol-decided-not-inherited — from
  B1 both open-time offer fields follow one matrix: known binds,
  unknown refuses, absent degrades to legacy.

ephemeralAuthorityProtocol.description:
Capability-first hosted ephemeral offer. Known binds, unknown refuses,
and absent degrades without failing durable connection use.

previousToken.description:
A prior grant's bearer. This field is deliberately absent from every
server response and from all receipt/capsule schemas.

wireVersion.description:
Exact wire-version offer (LLP 0094 §0B.3): a known token binds the
connection lineage, an unknown token refuses
(`SNAPBACK_WIRE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED`), absent opens a legacy lineage
implicitly bound to v1 for the socket-equality rule.

title: OpenConnectionRequest
